title: Draft the 5-sentence walk-in offer for a gym th… · T3-A-1

content.text:
Restart note: you reloaded every window at 13:36 AWST. Test whether the status bar follows the focused Claude tab when you switch sessions in the same workspace.

Here is the draft. It offers a rebuild, not a polish of their Squarespace site, because Solaisoft stopped selling in-place enhancement on 2026-09-18.

1. "Hi, I'm Macdara, I build websites for gyms around here, and I looked at yours before walking in."
2. "Three things stood out: [defect 1], [defect 2] and [defect 3], and they're costing you people who'd otherwise book a class."
3. "Squarespace can't fix those properly, so I'd build you a new site of your own, hosted and looked after by me, with no builder plan or plugins to pay for."
4. "I've already put together a quick look at what yours could be, and it takes two minutes to show you."
5. "Can I show you now, or is there a better time this week?"

- **Defects:** the three bracketed items must come from the real site (no booking link, slow mobile page, unclear class times). Check the site before you walk in. I haven't seen this gym's site, so I invented nothing.
- **Demo line:** sentence 4 only works if a demo exists. Run `/prospect-to-pitch` first, or cut the sentence.
- **Pricing:** I left it out because you didn't ask for it.
- **Your call on wording:** your rule is that you pick new copy lines from options. Tell me which sentences you want as 2-3 alternatives.
